user_query: Analyze this protein sequence comprehensively. Determine likely protein family and function, membrane topology, subcellular localization, domains, homolog-supported annotations, biological processes, and important uncertainties. Pay particular attention to whether it is a small multi-pass membrane protein or receptor.

warnings: Sequence-derived estimates assume an unmodified protein and do not account for processing, PTMs, bound ligands, or oligomers.
